# BackedSure

BackedSure is a South African specialist insurance platform for Professional Indemnity cover and related professional risk insurance.

## Key Pages

- Home: https://backedsure.co.za/
- Get a quote: https://backedsure.co.za/quote
- Professional Indemnity guide: https://backedsure.co.za/professional-indemnity
- PI cost guide: https://backedsure.co.za/professional-indemnity/cost
- Professions directory: https://backedsure.co.za/professions
- Claims: https://backedsure.co.za/claims
- Resources: https://backedsure.co.za/resources
- Contact: https://backedsure.co.za/contact
